claude_proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_reroll
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable's core mechanic is rerolling a failed saving throw. This is distinct from advantage (roll two dice simultaneously, take higher) and from modify_roll_numeric (additive delta to a single roll). The reroll replaces the failed result after it is known. modify_roll_reroll is present in the v4 taxonomy (TAXONOMY_atoms_graph.md §9 Effect Atoms) but absent from types.ts EffectAtom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level. You must use the new roll.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger.fail_saving_throw
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Indomitable triggers on ANY failed saving throw, not just saves against spells. The existing spell_save_outcome trigger is described as a 'Post-save spell reflection / conversion window' narrowed to saves against spells. A new trigger variant is needed: { kind: 'fail_saving_throw' } (or { kind: 'saving_throw_outcome'; outcome: 'failure' }) with no spell-source constraint. This enables the reaction/activation cost to correctly gate the reroll window.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you fail a saving throw, you can reroll it...

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceDelta.class_level
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The reroll bonus is 'equal to your Fighter level' — a class-level-scaled numeric bonus. The current DiceDelta variants are: fixed_dice, proficiency_bonus, ability_modifier, magic_item_rarity_bonus. None models a raw class level. A new variant { kind: 'class_level'; className: ClassName; sign: '+' | '-' } is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can reroll it with a bonus equal to your Fighter level
